transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Doctor. Thank you so much for seeing me, I really appreciate it. Um... well, to be honest, my wife is the one who really wanted me to come in. I hope that's alright. I've just been... struggling a bit lately, I guess. 

But what finally scared her—and I know this is going to sound a bit strange, I'm sorry—is that I keep hearing things. Just... water running inside the walls. And sometimes, um, it sounds like men whispering in there, even though nobody’s around. I try not to make a big deal out of it, really, I try to just ignore it. But then... well, sometimes I also see this dark, wet patch spreading across the hallway floor. But whenever I go over and check it, it's completely dry. 

I know it probably sounds crazy, and I'm really sorry to bother you with it. Am I making any sense?
How long have you been hearing the water running and the whispering voices?

Um... I guess it's been about seven months now? I really should have said something sooner, I'm sorry. I just kept hoping it would stop on its own and I wouldn't have to bother anyone with it. 

But yeah, about seven months. It started right after that bad winter freeze we had. It kind of... well, it turned all these house repairs I was trying to do into this huge mess, and I just couldn't get out from under it. I know I probably sound like I'm just making excuses for falling behind, and I really don't mean to. Is that... does that timeline make sense for this sort of thing?
Do the whispering voices you hear ever say anything that's related to your mood or how you're feeling?

Um... well, yes, I suppose they do. I mean, the timing definitely lines up with how bad I've been feeling. I hope I'm explaining this right, but... before those house problems dragged on and I really fell into this depression, I never heard any voices in the walls. Or saw those wet patches that weren't there. 

And, um... I'm really sorry, I probably should have mentioned this earlier, I was just so embarrassed and didn't want you to think I was completely losing my mind... but I also started thinking the neighbors were tracking me. I know how ridiculous that sounds, I really do. Please don't think terribly of me. 

But none of those strange things ever happened before. They only showed up after I had already stopped caring about my usual life, you know? It was only after I just started feeling like such a failure every single day that the voices and everything else started. I hope that answers your question... does that make sense to you?
Do the voices you hear or the things you see ever tell you or show you something that's related to your feelings of being a failure?

Um... no, not really. I mean, I hope I'm understanding you right, but the voices... they don't really say anything about me being a failure. They're just sort of... whispering about the pipes, or the water pressure, things like that. It's mostly just mumbling that I can't quite make out, to be honest. 

And the wet patch on the floor, it's just... a wet patch. It doesn't show me anything about myself. I'm sorry if that's not what you were looking for. I know I'm probably not explaining this very well. I just... I haven't noticed them saying anything mean about me, if that's what you mean. Is that a good thing? I hope that's a good sign.
Do you ever find it hard to express your thoughts or find the right words when talking to someone?

Um... well, yes, I suppose I do. I hope it's okay to admit that. I just... I don't want you to think I'm not trying to be helpful or that I'm not paying attention. It's just... 

My wife, she actually mentioned it the other day. She said I move like I'm underwater now. And... well, even just answering a simple question, like about a repair estimate or something, it can take me so long to get the words out that people just start talking for me. I feel terrible about it, really. I know it must be so frustrating for everyone around me, and for you too, probably, having to wait on me to finish a thought. 

I really am trying my best to keep up, I promise. I just... my brain feels so slow lately. Does that make sense? I hope I'm giving you the right kind of answers.
Have you been feeling persistently sad or empty for most of the day, nearly every day, over the past seven months?

Um... yes, I suppose so. I really hate to admit it, to be honest with you. I don't want you to think I'm just sitting around feeling sorry for myself, because I really do try to push through it and be strong. 

But... well, yes. Most days, I wake up and I just... I already feel like I've completely failed. Like I've failed at being a husband, and just... at being a man in general. And that heaviness, it just sits right on me from the moment I open my eyes until I finally go to bed. 

I feel terrible even saying it out loud, I know how pathetic it must sound to you. I really hope you don't judge me too harshly for feeling this way. I'm trying to be better, I promise. Does that answer what you were asking? I hope I'm giving you the right information.
Do the voices or the things you see ever seem to match or reflect how you're feeling at the time?

Um... no, I don't think so. I really hope I'm understanding you right, but the... the voices and the wet patch, they don't really seem to change based on how I'm feeling. 

I mean, even on the days when I'm feeling a little bit better—and I do try to have good days, I really do—the mumbling about the pipes is still just... there. And the wet patch on the floor, it's always the same, no matter if I'm feeling really down or if I'm trying to be positive. 

I'm sorry, I know that's probably not a very helpful answer. I just haven't noticed any kind of connection like that. I hope it's okay that they don't match up. Does that make sense? I really want to make sure I'm giving you the right kind of details.
Do the voices or the things you see ever seem to be related to your feelings of sadness or emptiness?

Um... well, it's kind of like I was saying before, I guess. I hope you don't mind me repeating myself, I just want to make sure I'm giving you what you need. 

But no, they don't really seem connected to the sadness. The voices, the mumbling... they don't really talk about me being a failure or feeling empty, if that's what you mean. They just keep going on about the pipes and the water. And the wet patch is just... it's just there on the floor. 

I'm sorry, I know you asked something similar just a moment ago. I hope I'm not frustrating you by not having a better answer. I really am trying to pay close attention to them for you, but they just seem to do their own thing, no matter how I'm feeling inside. Is that alright? I hope that's the kind of information you were looking for.
Did the voices and the wet patch start at the same time as your feelings of sadness and emptiness?

Um... well, no, they didn't start at exactly the same time. I hope I'm explaining this right for you. Before all the... the issues with the house dragged on and I really fell into this depression, I never heard any voices in the walls. And I never saw any wet patches that weren't there, or... well, or thought the neighbors were tracking me. 

I know how awful that last part sounds, I really do, and I'm so sorry to even bring it up. I don't want you to think I'm completely losing my mind or being difficult. But... yeah, those things, they only really showed up after I had already stopped caring about my usual life. They started after I was already waking up feeling like a failure every day. 

I hope that's helpful. Am I giving you the right kind of timeline? I just want to make sure I'm answering your questions properly.
Do you think the voices and visions would stop if your feelings of sadness and emptiness went away?

Um... gosh, I really hope so. I mean, it makes sense, right? I hope I'm not overstepping by guessing, but... well, like I mentioned just a minute ago, I never had any of these issues before I got so incredibly down about the house. 

I never used to hear those voices in the walls or see the wet spots on the floor before all of this. And... and I certainly never had those embarrassing thoughts about the neighbors watching me. I really hope you don't judge me too harshly for that part, I know it sounds so strange. 

But since none of that started until after I felt so completely defeated and stopped caring about my life... I'd like to think that if I could just get back to being myself, and stop waking up feeling like such a failure, maybe those other things would fade away too. Does that sound right to you? I really want to believe that's how it works. I hope I'm making sense.
Did the voices and visions appear after your feelings of sadness and emptiness became severe?

Um... yes, I think so. I'm sorry, I feel like I'm repeating myself a lot, and I really don't want to waste your time. I just want to be sure I'm giving you exactly what you need to hear. 

But yes, to answer your question... it was definitely after. Like I was trying to say earlier, before the house problems really dragged on and I fell so deeply into this... this depression, I never heard those voices in the walls. And I never saw the wet patches, or... or had those awful thoughts about the neighbors tracking me. I really hope you don't think I'm crazy for saying that. 

Those things... the voices and the patches... they only showed up after things got really bad. After I had already completely stopped caring about my usual life, and was just waking up feeling like a total failure every single day. 

I hope that answers your question properly. Is that the kind of detail you were looking for? I can try to explain it differently if that wasn't clear enough.
Did the voices and visions start after you had already been feeling sad and empty for a while?

Um... yes. Yes, they did. I... I know we keep circling back to this, and I really hope I'm not frustrating you by saying the same things over and over. I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information. 

But yes, it was definitely a while after. Like I mentioned, before the house problems dragged on for so long and I really fell into this... this deep rut, I never experienced any of this. I never heard the voices in the walls, or saw the wet patches, or... or had those embarrassing worries about the neighbors. 

It was really only after I had been down for quite some time... after I had already completely stopped caring about my usual routine and was waking up every single day just feeling like a total failure. That's when the other things started happening. 

I hope I'm explaining that clearly enough for you. Is that what you were asking? I can try to be more specific if you need me to.
Did the feelings of sadness and emptiness start before the voices and visions appeared?

Oh, gosh... yes. Yes, they did. I'm so sorry, I must be doing a really terrible job of explaining this if I'm making you ask it again. I promise I'm not trying to be difficult or confusing! Am I answering your questions okay? I really just want to make sure I'm giving you exactly what you need. 

But yes, to be completely clear, the sadness and emptiness were definitely there first. Before the house problems dragged on and I fell into this... this really dark place, I never heard those voices in the walls. I never saw those wet patches that weren't actually there, and... and I certainly didn't think the neighbors were tracking me. I'm still so embarrassed to even admit that part out loud, I really hope you don't judge me too harshly for it. 

All of those things only showed up after I had already completely stopped caring about my usual life... after I was already waking up feeling like a total failure every single day. So the sadness was definitely first. Did I say that right this time? I really hope that helps clarify things for you.
Have you ever had a period of time where you didn't hear the voices or see the wet patches for at least two weeks?

Um... no. No, I don't think so. I'm sorry, I hope that's not a bad thing to say. I just want to be completely honest with you so you can do your job. 

But since those things started... the voices and the patches... they haven't really gone away. Not for that long, anyway. I mean, maybe a day here or there where it's a little quieter, but definitely not two whole weeks. They're just... they're kind of always there now. 

I'm sorry, I know that probably makes me sound really, really unwell. I hope you don't think I'm beyond help or anything. I'm really trying my best to handle it. Is that... is that the kind of answer you were looking for? I can try to think harder if you need me to remember a specific time they stopped.
Do you notice any difference in the voices or visions when you have a slightly better day?

Um... well... I guess I don't really have many good days lately. I'm sorry, I wish I could give you a better answer. I really want to be helpful. 

But... um... like I was saying before, all of this... the voices in the walls, the wet patches, the embarrassing thoughts about the neighbors... none of that ever happened before the house problems dragged on and I fell into this depression. I really want to make sure you know that I wasn't always like this. I was normal before. 

It was only after I had already stopped caring about my usual life, you know? After I started feeling like such a failure every single day... that's when those things showed up. So... I guess since I've been feeling like a failure for so long now, the voices and visions just sort of stay the same. Because the sadness stays the same. 

Does that make sense? I hope I'm not rambling too much. I just really want to make sure I'm giving you the right information. Am I answering your question okay?
Have the voices and visions been present for at least one month?

Um... yes. Yes, definitely longer than a month. I'm sorry, I know that probably sounds terrible, like I should have gotten help sooner. I really hope you don't think I was just letting myself go on purpose. 

It's been... gosh, it's been going on for about seven months now. Ever since that awful winter freeze turned all the house repairs into this massive mess that I just... I couldn't get out from under. That's when everything really started. 

I'm so sorry I let it go on this long without seeing someone. I kept hoping I could just fix it myself, you know? I really didn't want to be a burden to anyone. Is... is seven months a really bad answer? I hope I'm not making your job too difficult by being such a complicated case.
Have the voices and visions been present continuously or on and off for the past seven months?

Um... I think... well, they've been pretty continuous, I suppose. I mean, not every single second of the day, but... they're around most of the time. 

I'm sorry, I hope that's not too frustrating to hear. I know it probably sounds like I'm not trying hard enough to ignore them or push them away. I really do try, I promise. I try to distract myself and focus on other things, but they just... they sort of linger in the background. 

It's not like they're screaming at me 24/7 or anything dramatic like that. Just... a steady presence, I guess. Since the winter. Is that... is that the right way to explain it? I want to make sure I'm giving you a clear picture so you know exactly how to treat me. I'm really sorry if I'm not explaining it well.
Have the voices and visions been present for most of every day over the past seven months?

Um... most of every day? I... I wouldn't want to exaggerate and make it sound worse than it is. I mean, they are there a lot, like I said, but... I don't want you to think I'm completely out of touch with reality from morning until night. 

I do have moments where things are quiet. Like when I'm really trying hard to just... sit still and not bother anybody. So maybe not *most* of every single day? I'm honestly not entirely sure how to measure it. I haven't been keeping a log or anything, which... I probably should have been doing, shouldn't I? I'm sorry, I should have been more prepared for this. 

I just... I don't want to give you the wrong idea. Does that make sense? I hope I'm answering this the way you need me to.
Have the voices and visions been present for at least two weeks without stopping?

Um... without stopping for two weeks? I... I don't think so. I mean, they definitely come and go, like I was saying. I hope that's okay. I really don't want to sound like I'm making a bigger deal out of this than it is. 

But, um, one thing I did want to make sure I explained right—and I'm sorry if I didn't say this clearly before—is that... well, none of this weird stuff, like the voices in the walls or seeing those wet patches that aren't really there, or... or thinking the neighbors were tracking me... none of that ever happened before the winter. 

Before the house problems dragged on and I just... fell into this horrible depression, I was totally fine. I mean, I never had anything like that happen. It was only after I'd already completely stopped caring about my usual life and just... started feeling like a failure every single day. That's when those things showed up. 

Does that make sense? I just want to make sure you know I wasn't always like this. I hope that's the right kind of information you need. I really want to be helpful.
Have the voices and visions lasted for at least one month without any significant breaks?

Um... a whole month without any breaks? No, no, I don't think so. I really don't think they've ever lasted that long without stopping. 

Like I said, I do get some quiet time, especially when I try really hard to just stay out of everyone's way. I don't want you to think I'm completely gone or anything like that. I'm really trying my best to manage it. 

So, no, definitely not a whole month straight. I hope that's a good sign? I mean, it means I'm not doing too terribly, right? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right answers so we can figure this out.
